description: This file implements database operations for managing notification hints in the focalboard server, including creating, updating, deleting, and fetching notification hints from the SQL database.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL database store for focalboard, with methods to manage notification hints.

methods.name: notificationHintFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a slice of NotificationHint models.

methods.name: upsertNotificationHint
methods.description: Creates or updates a notification hint in the database, setting the notify_at time based on notifyFreq.

methods.name: deleteNotificationHint
methods.description: Deletes a notification hint for a specific block ID.

methods.name: getNotificationHint
methods.description: Fetches a notification hint for a specific block ID.

methods.name: getNextNotificationHint
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled notification hint, optionally removing it from the database.
